title: The mission's own miscompile instrument has exited 1 on every observed dev CI run while GitHub reported the step success. Teach run.sh the measured platform asymmetry (kernel-read, fail-closed over exactly two verified host pairs), add a complete-coverage floor on the known-bad arm, then delete the single continue-on-error: true so the exit code carries its own meaning again - with one appended static test salting the ground the flag stood on. Three files modified, zero created, zero existing assertion bodies touched.

This plan uses aa0ab05.

A red whose text says `AILANG_BIN is unset` is NOT this diff - do not fix it, do not make those tests skip (they t.Fatalf on purpose).

SECOND SHARPEST FACT: `go test ./host/verifygate/ -run '^TestMiscompileInstrumentStepIsGatedInCI$' -count=1` is rc=0 AT BASE with `ok ... 0.172s [no tests to run]` and ZERO `=== RUN` lines. Any acceptance step reading that command's exit code is VACUOUS. Charter row 33. The binding form adds -v and counts `=== RUN` / `--- PASS` / `--- FAIL`, with a nonsense-pattern control in the same breath (base-measured: `-run '^TestNoSuchWiringGateZZZ$' -v` prints `no tests to run` 2x and exits 0).

The two SCOPED text-scanning tests (AC1, AC3) need NO AILANG_BIN - they are pure text scans over ci.yml / run.sh / go.mod with no subprocess. Run them unexported so their lane-independence stays visible.

`./scripts/verify_go.sh` legitimately emits exactly 2 `WARNING: DATA RACE` lines from its OWN known-positive control in design_docs/verification/w-race-gate-blindspot/racecontrol/, under the banner `-- race-detector known-positive control` (verify_go.sh:226/:229/:232). Three prior iterations have had to attribute these. NOT a finding. Do not report them.
Every `ailang` invocation prints `Observatory: NNNMB (warn threshold: 200MB)` on stderr; rc=0 with it present. NOT a regression.
`git status --porcelain` is NEVER empty during this sprint. The deliverable is uncommitted by construction. Integrity is checked by sha256 against /tmp/p44-backup/POST_SPRINT.sha, never by porcelain.

RESTORES DURING THE MUTATION DRILL USE `cp` FROM /tmp/p44-backup/, NEVER `git checkout --`. Nothing is committed, so `git checkout -- design_docs/verification/w-race-gate-blindspot/run.sh` would DELETE milestone M1 entirely with no undo.
